_README: Ratchet baseline for the pull-request quality gate.
The application predates any lint or type-check gate, so a strict pass/fail
run would fail on every pull request and teach reviewers to ignore it.
Instead each check below records the finding count measured on the trunk at
the time the gate was introduced. A pull request fails when it pushes a
count ABOVE its recorded maximum, so existing debt is visible and frozen
When a pull request reduces a count, lower max_findings in the same commit.
Never raise a max_findings value to make a pull request pass: fix the
finding instead. Tool versions are pinned in requirements.txt because these
counts are only reproducible for a fixed tool version.
The unit-test and per-file coverage gate from scripts/check_coverage.py is NOT ratcheted.
It is enforced absolutely at 90% by scripts/check_coverage.py.

flake8-errors.title: Lint (correctness)
flake8-errors.description: Syntax errors, undefined names and invalid comparisons: code that is broken rather than merely untidy.

flake8-style.title: Lint (full)
flake8-style.description: Full flake8 run using .flake8. Advisory: reported on the pull request but does not fail the build.

mypy.description: mypy over app/ using the [tool.mypy] settings in pyproject.toml.
